name: Hoteru
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional city hotel (Komorebi Hotel): an elevator inspection notice, a first day helping at the front desk, a breakfast guide, a room-only plan notice, a check-in process guide, a reflection on learning from a guest interaction, a report on teaching a new staff member how to handle check-in, an essay on why early check-in grew popular, a typhoon/heavy-rain contingency guide, a column on the diversifying room styles, a notice of revised cancellation rules, a reflection on what stays at a hotel, and a one-year cooperation report on a partnership with the local shopping association. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
